title: Build an AI Vision Rover
shortDescription: Build a smart rover that recognises and follows selected objects using a camera and onboard AI.
fullDescription: Build a smart rover that recognises and follows selected objects using a camera and onboard AI. Wire the drive system, train a simple vision model and test it in a practical lab.
courseBreakdown: Build, test and tune follow mode

title: Build a Muscle-Controlled Robotic Hand
shortDescription: Control a robotic hand using an EMG muscle sensor and discover human-machine interaction.
fullDescription: Control a robotic hand using an EMG muscle sensor. Learn how muscle signals become movement in a supportive, beginner-friendly build session.

title: Mini-Sumo Robot Battle Day
shortDescription: Build, program and compete with a tiny autonomous robot in a high-energy tournament.
fullDescription: Build, program and compete with a tiny autonomous robot in a high-energy tournament. Teams learn sensors, strategy and rapid iteration before the arena battles.

title: Build an ESP32 Smart Home and Security Hub
shortDescription: Control lights, doors and sensors from your phone with a practical connected-home build.
fullDescription: Wire an ESP32 hub, connect sensors and leave with a secure working smart-home dashboard for your phone.

title: Build a Vision-Guided Robotic Arm
shortDescription: Teach a robotic arm to identify, pick and sort objects with camera-guided movement.
fullDescription: Explore calibration, motion planning and factory automation by teaching a robotic arm to identify and sort objects.
courseBreakdown: Set up and calibrate the arm

title: Build a LoRa Off-Grid Communicator
shortDescription: Send messages across distance without Wi-Fi or cellular service using low-power radio.
fullDescription: Build and test a resilient LoRa communicator designed for farms, hikes and off-grid adventures.

title: Build a Self-Balancing Robot
shortDescription: Learn motors, sensors and PID control by making a two-wheel robot balance itself.
fullDescription: Understand feedback and real-world control by building, tuning and balancing a two-wheel robot.

title: Design and Assemble Your Own ESP32 PCB
shortDescription: Create a custom circuit board from schematic to working ESP32 prototype.
fullDescription: Move from idea to schematic, layout and assembly with practical guidance at every step.
courseBreakdown: Lay out and order the PCB

title: Service Your Own Car
shortDescription: Learn oil, filters, spark plugs and essential inspections that keep your car reliable.
fullDescription: Work through a real service checklist and gain confidence under the bonnet with guided practical work.
whatYouNeed: Your car or a shared vehicle

title: OBD Diagnostics and Used-Car Inspection
shortDescription: Read warning lights, spot costly faults and avoid buying a bad vehicle.
fullDescription: Learn a repeatable inspection process using OBD data and your own eyes and ears before buying used.

title: Start a Mobile Car-Detailing Business
shortDescription: Turn clean cars into a practical side business with pricing, packages and professional results.
fullDescription: Practise a repeatable interior and exterior workflow you can sell immediately, with simple business guidance.

title: Install Dashcams, Reverse Cameras and Parking Sensors
shortDescription: Install popular vehicle electronics safely, or turn the skill into a paid service.
fullDescription: Learn routing, power, testing and tidy finishing on a practical vehicle setup.

title: Headlight Restoration Side Hustle
shortDescription: Learn a low-cost service with dramatic before-and-after results and repeat customers.
fullDescription: Restore clarity, protect the finish and learn how to price the job profitably.

title: Furniture Flipping for Profit
shortDescription: Restore, photograph and list a piece that people want to buy.
fullDescription: Learn how to find undervalued furniture, transform it with confidence and price it for profit.
whatYouNeed: An open mind for second-hand finds

title: Start a Personalised Products Business
shortDescription: Make shirts, labels, signs, mugs and decals people are excited to order.
fullDescription: Build a small product range, learn clean finishing and leave with a simple sales plan.

title: Upholster Your Own Chair
shortDescription: Learn a valuable upholstery skill while completing a transformation you can see and use.
fullDescription: Strip, measure, cut and finish a chair with patient hands-on guidance.
